description.value: Pizza 64 is a fast-casual pizza chain with a Richmond location in a strip-mall unit on Thorpe Road. The restaurant offers both walk-in pickup and delivery, with indoor seating available. It is part of a multi-location BC franchise with an online ordering system.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the OSM address (11780 Thorpe Rd #120, Richmond, BC V6X 1J6) and supplies a phone number absent from OSM. The site explicitly offers both takeout pickup and delivery. No cycling-specific amenities — bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging — are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone 604-229-1818 sourced from website only.
OSM address field omits unit number; website-confirmed full address is 11780 Thorpe Rd #120.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is clearly open and offers takeout, which is relevant to touring cyclists, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from the available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify before listing.
